commits.messageBody:
Secrets can now be fetched from Google Cloud Secret Manager at startup
(GCP_SECRET_LOADER=true), eliminating the requirement for a local .env
file on every machine. Falls back gracefully to .env for local dev.

Also: remove stale Resend reference from env validation, add SMTP vars
to validation schema, bump ENV_SCHEMA_VERSION to 1.1.0.

https://claude.ai/code/session_01BNa7ckaxxB66qf4YJVjdu6
commits.messageHeadline: Add GCP Secret Manager loader to remove laptop .env dependency

commits.messageBody:
VAULT_PROVIDER=aiven stores secrets in Aiven PostgreSQL (Finnish company,
no CLOUD Act exposure). Bootstrap needs only AIVEN_DATABASE_URL ΓÇö all other
secrets loaded from app_secrets table at startup.

- secret-loader.ts v2.0: multi-provider (aiven, gcp), legacy GCP_SECRET_LOADER compat
- provision-secrets-aiven.ts: push .env ΓåÆ Aiven (npx tsx scripts/provision-secrets-aiven.ts)
- .env.example: documented VAULT_PROVIDER, bumped ENV_SCHEMA_VERSION 1.1.0

commits.messageBody:
6 issues from self-audit:
1. SECURITY: secrets now encrypted with pgcrypto pgp_sym_encrypt (AES-256)
   ΓÇö requires AIVEN_VAULT_KEY passphrase, stored separately from DB URL
2. SECURITY: AIVEN_DATABASE_URL + AIVEN_VAULT_KEY added to SKIP_KEYS
   ΓÇö prevents storing vault credentials inside the vault (circular)
3. BUG: pg moved from devDependencies to dependencies (production crash)
4. STALE: app.ts comment updated for multi-provider vault
5. INCONSISTENCY: validate-env service log shows Aiven/GCP vault status
6. ADDED: AIVEN_VAULT_KEY to .env.example with generation command
